faq_heading: Central Coquitlam houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Central Coquitlam. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Central Coquitlam, Coquitlam: 64 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 9 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 4 of 23 Coquitlam communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Central Coquitlam fell from 80 in June to 64 in September (−20.0%), and 52 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 15.1% of Coquitlam’s 425 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Central Coquitlam?
Central Coquitlam also had 36 condos and townhomes listed and 5 sold in September, against 64 houses listed. The Central Coquitlam condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Central Coquitlam home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

88 houses sold in Central Coquitlam with a median price of $1,564,000 (the middle half sold between $1,393,750 and $1,801,250), taking a median of 21 days to sell at 95.8% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $593 per square foot, a median year built of 1972 and a median lot of 7,920 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Central Coquitlam?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 64 houses listed in Central Coquitlam. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Central Coquitlam a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Central Coquitlam had a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Central Coquitlam from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 52 houses sold in Central Coquitlam over those 4 months, out of 219 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Central Coquitlam?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Central Coquitlam sell for?
faq.a: 88 houses sold in Central Coquitlam between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,564,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Central Coquitlam?
faq.a: The median was 21 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.8% of the last list price (9% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
